subject: Mobile Development
title: The Onboarding Funnel
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Onboarding Funnel usable.

hook.text: 77% of users abandon an app within 3 days of installing it. Onboarding decides their fate.

buildup.text: The onboarding flow guides new users from first open to the moment they find value.

discovery.text: Apps that deliver their core value within the first 60 seconds retain 3x more users.

twist.text: Forcing users to create accounts before seeing value is the top cause of onboarding drop-off.

climax.text: The first minute decides if a user stays forever or leaves and never returns.

punchline.text: Sixty seconds to show value — or lose the user.

quiz.question: What is the biggest cause of onboarding drop-off?
options: Forcing account creation before showing value
